name: Waimakariri District Council
story: Waimakariri District Council used GIS in its 2005 District Plan production. Its 1 July 2008 engineering standard required reserve as-built GIS layers in GeoMedia format and NZMG coordinates. The council supplied existing layers for contractors to update.

Terralink’s 4 March 2004 announcement names Waimakariri District Council as a participant in the shared South Island orthophoto acquisition. The release describes regional imagery for local-government GIS, consent processing, land-use work, civil defence and asset management. This evidence establishes participation in the shared imagery project; it does not identify the council’s internal GIS platform or named practitioners.

sources.label: Waimakariri District Council Engineering Code of Practice, Part 12 As-Builts, QP-C821 Issue 1
Terralink International, ‘Terralink starts biggest ever aerial photography task’, 4 March 2004
